GMB.note: States nothing on statistics from administrative records.
Names a national ID card as a requirement but states no exchange of records between civil register and ID system.

facts.fact: Ministry of Health's Deputy Director of Civil Registration said on 24 June 2024 that over one million Gambians have received new digital birth certificates, issued in all public health facilities across the country.
facts.system: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics system

GMB.note: The one million figure is digital birth certificates and health insurance registrations, with no national ID count or population share.
Digital birth certificates are described, but no unique ID number given at birth.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.
No public register keyed on the national ID number is described.
National ID system itself is not described, only a card as a document requirement.

facts.fact: Ministry of Health's Deputy Director of Civil Registration said on 24 June 2024 that births are registered and digital birth certificates issued by public health officers in all public health facilities; deaths are not mentioned.
